correctness.rationale: For synchronous indexed cyclic Rule 110, each precursor is one closed labeled path in the explicit four-state pair graph. Label-one recurrent 3x3 matrix has characteristic t^3-t-1 and traces P_n. With a zero label, exact 2x2 H-gap reduction and H_(k+3)=H_(k+1)+H_k reduce all-output maximization to entrywise D(a,b)=H_(a+b+1)-H_a H_b. I independently recomputed all 19 integer base differences; the stated bivariate recurrence extends them to all a,b positive except (1,2). In a cyclic sequence of at least two positive gaps there is necessarily a nonexceptional adjacent ordered pair, so monotone trace merging bounds all zero-containing outputs by h_(m-1); the Perrin minus h recurrence makes it strictly smaller for n>=5. Exceptional n=1..4 follow finite exact labeled graph counts. Finite checks supplement the recurrence proof, not replace it.
